content: Amakeerenʼya
Inyɨ umwimiiririri wa risengerero, nɨrakwandɨkɨra awɨ umusubhaati wʉnʉ ʉrʉbhwɨrwɨ na Mungu, hamwɨmwɨ na abhaana bhaazʉ
bhanʉ nɨsɨɨgirɨ kʉmaheene. Ɨtarɨ inyimwene, nawe na abhandɨ bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhɨɨzɨ amaheene.
Nɨbhasɨɨgirɨ kʉ kʉbha itwɨ na niimwɨ tʉmɨnyirɨ amaheene, na tʉrakaja komenya kwa kemerano.
Ɨbhɨgʉngi, rigʉngi no omorembe kurwa kwa Bhaabha Mungu, na kʉMʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ, bhɨbhɨ na niitwɨ, bhanʉ tukutuna amaheene nʉ ʉbhʉsɨɨgi.
Ʉkʉsɨɨgana nekwe ukwisirirya amaswaja ga Mungu
Nɨkazomerwa bhʉkʉngʼu korora abhaana bhaazʉ obhorebhe bharatuna ɨnzɨra ya amaheene, chɨmbu Bhaabha Mungu aatuswajiryɨ.
Nangʉ, umusubhaati ʉmʉsɨɨgwa, nɨrakʉsabha ugwatɨ amaswaja ganʉ gakubhuga tʉsɨɨganɨ. Amaswaja gayo gatarɨ mahya, nawe nɨ‑garyagarya twarɨ nagʉ kwɨma hanʉ mwatangirɨ kwisirirya.
Ʉkʉsɨɨgana nekwe ukugwata amaswaja ga Mungu. Rɨnʉ neryo riswaja rɨnʉ mwigwirɨ kwɨma ʉbhʉtangɨ kʉbha mwikarɨ kwʉ ʉbhʉsɨɨgi.
Amaangirijʉ igʉrʉ wa abhakangirirya
Nɨragambabhu kʉ kʉbha abhakangirirya bhaaru bhabhʉnɨkirɨ kʉʉsɨ. Bhatakwisirirya Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ akiibhurwa ʉmʉʉtʉ.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akubhugabhu, nɨ‑mʉkangirirya, na ni‑mubhisa wa Kiriisitʉ.
Mmbe, mwiyangarɨrɨ imubheene, korereke emeremo janyu gɨtaaza kʉbhʉra bhʉʉha, nawe mʉsʉngʼaanɨ kurwa kwa Mungu ririhi rinagu.
Wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akuja hagarɨ na amiija ga Kiriisitʉ, wuyo ataana ubhumwɨmwɨ na Mungu. Nawe, wʉnʉ akongʼeha kugwata amiija ga Kiriisitʉ, wuyo anu ubhumwɨmwɨ na Bhaabha Mungu nu Umwana waazɨ wʉʉsi.
Arɨɨbhɨ wʉwʉʉsi araaza kwa niimwɨ wʉnʉ atakwija gayo, mʉtamuginihya mumijɨ janyu, na mʉtamokeerya nchu Umukiriisitʉ ʉmʉkɨndichanyu.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akomokeerya, arɨ hamwɨmwɨ nawe mʉmangʼana gaazɨ amabhɨ.
Amakeerenʼya gʉ ʉkʉraga
Nɨna amangʼana maaru gʉ ʉkʉgamba, nawe nɨtakwenda kwandɨka kʉnzɨra yɨ ɨnyarʉbha. Kʉgayo, niriisega kuuza kwa niimwɨ kʉbhataarɨra na kwibhisirya hamwɨmwɨ, korereke obhozomerwa bhwɨtʉ bhuhikɨ.
Abhaana bhu umusubhaati waazʉ wʉnʉ arʉbhwɨrwɨ na Mungu,
bharakokeerya.
